title: Tree-ring widths from one stand
description: Annual ring widths for 2014 to 2023 measured on cores from two invented sugar maples in one stand, with the latewood part of each ring. Every tree and width is invented.
archive:methods: One 5 mm core per tree was taken at breast height in October 2023, sanded, and measured to 0.01 mm on a sliding stage under a microscope.
